<!--
Please fill out the sections below. Keep descriptions clear and concise.

**Title prefix:** `bug:`

## What happened

Describe the bug: what went wrong, what you expected instead.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Reproduction steps

1. Step 1
2. Step 2
3. ...

Include commands, inputs, and relevant configuration if applicable.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g., macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Node/Bun version: [e.g., Bun 1.1.0]
- Plugin version: [e.g., 0.1.0]

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Bug is reproducible with provided steps
- [ ] Root cause is identified
- [ ] Fix is implemented with tests
- [ ] All quality gates pass (lint, typecheck, test)

## Out of scope

What will NOT be done in this issue (e.g., refactoring, feature additions)?

## Reference

Reference to [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) if relevant to the issue context (e.g., agent-driven workflow, quality standards).
